answer: No, Amcor does not have an improving gross margin profile as of FY2023. Gross profit as a percentage of net sales decreased from 21.2% in FY2021 ($2,732 million gross profit on $12,861 million net sales) to 19.4% in FY2022 ($2,820 million gross profit on $14,544 million net sales), and further declined to 18.5% in FY2023 ($2,725 million gross profit on $14,694 million net sales).
rationale: The user asks if Amcor has an improving gross margin profile as of FY2023. Gross margin is useful and tracked explicitly by the company. The figures from the 10-K show gross profit percentage declining from 21.2% (FY2021) to 19.4% (FY2022) and 18.5% (FY2023).
